truthMethod: Fixed from the manually read pinned PostGIS operations source and CPython AST before running this question against either product. This is a contrasting held-out question on a known development repository, not an unseen project: the operations file is irrelevant to the existing PostgreSQL connection.info.server_version question, but necessary here. Scope is fetching the PostGIS library scalar through SQL and converting that scalar to a tuple; connection initialization, schema changes and test-database creation are outside scope. Base temporary-connection lifecycle is optional supporting context. Other returned files are unjudged. No product ranking rule was tuned in the audit batch, and this question must not be used to justify a file-path exclusion for the PostgreSQL case.
